title: nikos.plan.yaml: a code repo's link to its planning repo, and the settings its maps take from it
description: Written by nikos join and refreshed by nikos settings pull. A version newer than 1 is refused before this schema runs.

levels.description: Settings files from the top down, each with the folder it came from (e.g. teams/WEB).

format_version.description: The version of this file's format. nikOS reads 1.

repo.description: The planning repo's path on its host: owner/repo, or group/subgroup/project on GitLab.

host.description: The host, when it isn't github.com.

url.description: The git url to read from, when it isn't derived from host and repo. Never carries a password.

commit.description: The planning repo's commit the snapshot was read from.

at.description: When it was read, as an ISO time.

ref.description: The branch read. Absent means the planning repo's default branch.

company.description: The company's settings. Every map takes these, whatever its owner.

owners.description: Each owning team's chain, below the company, keyed by the team's key (e.g. WEB). An owner with no team in the plan has no entry.

sha256.description: A hash of company and owners. It catches a hand edit; it is not security.
